app.title: Sail: learn and train
scene.label: 3D view of the boat
scene.unavailable: The 3D view could not start on this device.
panel.label: Controls
view.step.label: Step size
view.step.hint: How much one tap on − or + changes a rope.
view.debug.label: Debug overlay
view.debug.hint: Shows frame rate, layout and build version. Useful for bug reports.
view.placeholder: Labels in 3D, the rope colour legend, Share link and Reset come in later steps.
debug.title: Debug
cam.label: Camera
cam.hint: Port is the left side of the boat when you face the bow (the front); starboard is the right side. Drag the 3D view to look around: the camera then switches to Free.
card.label: Selected part
ropes.hint: The ropes that control the mainsail (the big sail behind the mast). This is a temporary list: a drawing of the real clutch banks (the rows of rope locks by the wheels) comes in a later step, the jib in the next one.
furl.hint: Mainsail out moves three rope ends together: to unfurl, the “out” furling tail and the outhaul are hauled in while the “in” tail pays out. To furl, the other way round. The sail rolls into the mast from its back edge.
wind.hint: A test wind you set by hand. The boat does not move: this is the wind the sails feel.
wind.dial.label: Wind direction
wind.dial.hint: Drag around the ring, or use − and +. The arrow comes from where the wind blows from. The boat's bow (front) points up.
wind.less: Wind more from the port side
wind.more: Wind more from the starboard side
wind.speed.label: Wind speed
wind.presets.label: Wind presets
wind.preset.head: Head to wind
alert.gybe: GYBE! The boom swung across the boat
main.calm: No wind: the mainsail hangs loose, boom {angle}° out
main.furled: Mainsail furled (rolled into the mast): no sail for the wind to push, boom {angle}° out
